title: jacobaea carniolica
intro: Jacobaea carniolica, commonly known as Carinthian knapweed, is a perennial plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Jacobaea carniolica include reducing inflammation, wound healing, and antiviral activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
